# Does the EU Data Act apply to your connected product or cloud service?

> Free EU Data Act checker: pick your role and size to see whether Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 likely applies, whether the micro and small enterprise exemption covers you, the Article behind it, the dates and the main duties. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
